segments.text:
V. 29.
Lo, ſo many years do I ſerve thee—So he was one of the Inſtances mentioned, ver. 7. How admirably therefore does this Parable confirm that Aſſertion! Yet thou never gaveſt me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends—Perhaps GOD does not uſually give much Joy to thoſe who never felt the Sorrows of Repentance.
